text_block_list.text:
One day at lunch break, 
I went to see <chrname> and found her 
talking with some unexpected company.

text_block_list.name: Kiryūin Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer <username>. 
I was just hearing all sorts of things 
from <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
France... the Arc de Triomphe... 
There's so much I don't know... how exciting.

It seemed they had asked <chrname> 
to tell them about her experiences 
on Project L'Arc.

text_block_list.name: Kiryūin Aoi
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, Trainer <username>, 
please share your own account as well, for our edification!
choice_data_list: Talk about the city of Paris

text_block_list.text:
Paris is called the city of art for good reason-- 
everything <chrname> and I saw there 
was beautiful.

Glimpsed between training sessions, those sights were 
nourishment for <chrname>'s heart and mine 
--that was the memory I shared.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely memory... how nice... 
Someday I'd like to, with my trainer... mm.

text_block_list.name: Kiryūin Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer <username>. 
You're taking on the challenge again this year, aren't you? 
The Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Kiryūin Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Meek and I are both cheering for you from the heart. 
As the goal we ought to aim for...!

The Arc de Triomphe is the world's premier race, 
and its stands have the air of high society, 
filled with gentlemen and ladies of the first rank--

Because of that, the tension in the air felt different 
from a Japanese racecourse, and it focused the mind 
--that was the memory I shared.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
The world... the first rank... my heart's pounding... 
Someday I'd like to, with my trainer... mm.
